findings.reason: §19 must add the schema reconciliation to its scope (retire or re-annotate the CodeChunk.code_example_id relationship slot so one name describes the one writer-created edge) or its stated done-when and its "the schema does not declare" premise are both false.
findings.text: CodeChunk.code_example_id is an unannotated range: CodeExample slot, so it auto-derives the relationship name CODE_EXAMPLE_ID (generated into imas_codex/graph/schema_context_data.py:2073 and referenced at imas_codex/graph/schema.py:693), yet the chunk writer creates the parent edge as (CodeExample)-[:HAS_CHUNK]->(CodeChunk) (imas_codex/ingestion/pipeline.py:522); §19 removes the one reader of the declared CODE_EXAMPLE_ID arm but leaves the schema still declaring a parent relationship no writer materialises, so the generated schema context keeps advertising a phantom edge and §19's own done-when — `rg 'CODE_EXAMPLE_ID|CodeFile\)-\[:HAS_CHUNK\]|coalesce\(.*source_file' imas_codex` matching "only the helper" — cannot hold, because schema_context_data.py:2073 matches

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — §19's one renderer in imas_codex/ingestion/graph.py hides a two-hop OPTIONAL MATCH plus the ce/cc.source_file coalesce behind a single parameterised call that five sites embed, replacing five hand-inlined joins with one interface smaller than what it hides.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §19 leaves the schema declaring its own name for the same parent edge (CodeChunk.code_example_id -> CODE_EXAMPLE_ID) while pinning every reader on the writer's HAS_CHUNK edge; the plan mis-states that edge as "the schema does not declare".
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0 this week; §19 states in its own text "Interface budget: nothing added", §14 adds only a key to an existing dict and a key in the seed item (no new CLI option, MCP view or refusal family), and the existing --root entry point is reused.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — §14 extends the existing seed_facility_roots (imas_codex/discovery/paths/frontier.py:426) and PATH_RESET_SPECS (imas_codex/discovery/base/reset.py:240), and §19 opens the five divergent chunk-source readers (_enrich_code_chunks search_tools.py:1665, find_code domain_queries.py:480, code-context lookup discovery/signals/parallel.py:203, _search_code_chunks llm/server.py:827, schema_context.py:95) plus the single writer ingestion/pipeline.py:522; every citation verified present in the tree.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — neither implementable section adds a forwarding layer: §14 extends existing functions in place, and §19 consolidates five readers onto one owner rather than wrapping them.
